ranked_proposals.evidence: Gen10 provides immutable coherent epochs and Gen11 now proves which authority obligations belong to the task; together they create the missing substrate for meaningful counterfactual comparisons.
ranked_proposals.expected_benefit: Ask what would have happened under another implementation, routing rule, evaluator, or authority choice while keeping evidence epoch and historical scope fixed.
ranked_proposals.name: Counterfactual Replay over Intent-Routed Evidence Epochs
ranked_proposals.scope_guard: Do not turn replay into autonomous promotion or weaken fail-closed authority.
ranked_proposals.thesis: Replay alternate decisions against sealed, route-provenance-bound evidence without mutating current accepted state.

ranked_proposals.evidence: Gen11 retained Gen10 exposed a real three-level Gen10 -> Gen9 -> protected-ablation capsule failure with Linux OverlayFS exit 32 even though semantic metrics were all green.
ranked_proposals.expected_benefit: Allow higher-generation evaluators to delegate destructive child tests to an existing isolation owner without unsafe nesting or false regression failures.
ranked_proposals.name: Hierarchical Experiment Isolation / Nested Evaluation Delegation
ranked_proposals.scope_guard: No new host authority and no permanent MCP tools required.
ranked_proposals.thesis: Make nested benchmark/capsule composition explicit instead of accidentally stacking OverlayFS namespaces.

ranked_proposals.evidence: Gen11 frozen adversarial gold found two real classifier defects before acceptance; Gen8 capsules and Gen10 epochs provide safe test isolation/provenance.
ranked_proposals.expected_benefit: Increase confidence that routing, freshness and evaluator rules reject plausible regressions rather than merely passing curated positive cases.
ranked_proposals.name: Evaluator Mutation Nursery
ranked_proposals.scope_guard: Mutation testing only; no production self-mutation/promotion automation.
ranked_proposals.thesis: Systematically mutate intent/routing/evaluator implementations and prove frozen gold rejects unsafe or semantically wrong descendants.

ranked_proposals.evidence: Gen9 can prove evidence necessity, Gen10 stabilizes temporal provenance, and Gen11 distinguishes task authority; these reduce risk of merging things that only share vocabulary.
ranked_proposals.expected_benefit: Reduce accumulated capability/context surface while preserving lineage and recovery.
ranked_proposals.name: Capability Consolidation + Supersession Proofs
ranked_proposals.thesis: Identify semantically overlapping retained capabilities/memories and consolidate only with evaluator, regression, routing and epoch provenance proofs.

ranked_proposals.evidence: The core now has stable tooling, memory, Twin, context compilation/minimization, epochs and intent routing.
ranked_proposals.expected_benefit: Make the eventual fork evidence-driven without prematurely implementing full project onboarding in Gen12.
ranked_proposals.name: Project Onboarding Readiness Gate
ranked_proposals.scope_guard: Readiness only unless a future generation explicitly authorizes the branch.
ranked_proposals.thesis: Define readiness criteria and a thin adapter contract for the planned outward project/domain branch around Gen13.
